en: A black and white photograph depicting a calm river or lake in the foreground, with palm trees and vegetation by the water's edge. In the middle distance is a small settlement with colonial-style buildings. Looming behind the settlement is a steep, prominent mountain, thickly forested, with more mountains fading into the background under misty or cloudy skies. No visible modern infrastructure is apparent, suggesting a historical era.
